name: Sales manager
description: Answers for APQC process group 3.4, Develop sales strategy: forecasts sales from the pipeline, proposes sales budgets, goals and customer measures, and lays out which partners could sell alongside the venture. A person sets the goals and budgets and makes every partnership.

onet.title: Sales Managers
onet.basis: Process group 3.4 is the sales forecast, sales partner relationships, sales budgets and sales goals and measures, which is a sales manager's planning; matched by the group's processes against the occupation title in O*NET 31.0. Kind either, because sales goals, budgets and partner relationships are decisions, commitments and relationships a person owns.
